I can't answer that from this evidence. The tool checked 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03, which is the month after your date, not the two weeks before it. The result for that window was no NASA FIRMS thermal detections intersecting the property. All sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day. That result says nothing about 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-04.

Even for the window it did check, "not detected" doesn't prove no fire. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can be missed. The result also says nothing about burned area or cause.

To answer your question, the check needs to be rerun for roughly 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-04.
